what: `.bcard { transition: transform 0.3s }` is dead motion with the built-in `ease`: the card's transform is a fixed nth-child tilt that never changes, so nothing ever animates; the chapter also carries its own reduced-motion and `:root:not(.motion)` overrides for it.
evidence: assets/ext/go-ch16.css `.bcard { … transition: transform 0.3s; }`, `:root:not(.motion) .bcard { transition: none; }`, `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .bcard { transition: none; } }`. motion.js (getComputedStyle on every element, 1280): li.bcard transform 300ms ease is the only chapter-owned transition on ch16-20; every other control uses the engine's 160ms --ease-out press. With prefers-reduced-motion and with 'Animations: off', L.motionOn() is false and no animation ran while stepping all steppers on any of the five pages.
fix: `.bcard { transition: transform 0.3s }` → delete it and both overrides (why: Emil remedy 1, delete motion with no purpose; if a stamp-in is wanted, `.bcard.pass .bstamp { animation: pop-in var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out) both }` reuses the engine entrance).
